prompt: 16:9 cinematic wide frame, oriental immortal realm hyper-scale environmental scene, refined cinematic matte painting, photorealistic fantasy environment, gray-blue twilight series. An oriental divine civilization floating above an endless sea of clouds, with architectural scales approaching geological features. The entire image revolves around a single spatial theme: a massive royal celestial palace hanging upside down from the sky, its lower part descending like an artificial mountain range covering the heavens. The camera stands inside a high-altitude white jade terrace at an eye level of about 1.4 meters, using a 35mm wide-angle lens, looking straight ahead with a slight upward tilt. No aerial shots, no bird's-eye views. The foreground left is heavily framed by an exceptionally large vermilion lacquer pillar, oily dark wood beams, and dark cyan double-eaves pressing into the top of the frame; the right side uses a semi-transparent cyan jade screen and carved white jade balustrades to form a second framing layer. The middle ground is a very wide but empty royal white jade terrace, its polished jade surface reflecting the cold gray sky, with only 3 tiny immortals (about 1% of frame height) standing quietly at the end. Beyond the terrace, it drops immediately into a massive cloud sea fault. In the distance above, a whole inverted royal palace hangs down from above the clouds. It is not just a building, but an entire sky continent carved into a palace: inverted eaves, giant brackets, white jade platforms, dark wood pillars, and dark cyan glazed roofs form a giant artificial landscape. Only a portion is visible. At least 50% of the inverted architecture is obscured by high-altitude gray-blue mist, cloud curtains, foreground eaves, and the frame. The uppermost connection disappears into the sky, while the descending ends are swallowed by blue-gray clouds, leaving the thickness and height of the palace ambiguous. Some parts even show massive inverted courtyards and descending bases, but do not add a second visual protagonist. About 80% of the frame is controlled by gray-blue sky, blue-gray cloud sea, cold air, and deep cyan-gray shadows. Royal materials are extremely refined: vermilion high-gloss lacquer pillars, dark wood beams, white jade platforms, delicate jade screens, dark cyan glazed eaves, and partially gilded bracket edges. Gold is strictly controlled, appearing only on edges. Soft directional light from the right passes through clouds, creating a tiny amount of amber rim light on the eaves and beams. Foreground detail is sharp, mid-ground moderate, and distant massive blocks are simplified into dark gray-blue silhouettes. Cold large field + warm localized accents + luminous ivory mist, monumental inverted celestial palace as artificial terrain, architecture swallowing the sky, solemn stillness, deep atmospheric layering, large depth of field, no ruined architecture, no crowded palace city, no sci-fi spacecraft feeling.

promptZh: 16:9 电影宽画幅，东方仙境超大规模环境场景，精致的电影级绘景，照片级写实奇幻环境，灰蓝色暮色系列。一座东方神圣文明漂浮在无尽云海之上，建筑规模堪比地质特征。整个画面围绕单一空间主题展开：一座巨大的皇家天宫从天而降倒悬，其下部如同人工山脉覆盖苍穹。摄像机位于高海拔白玉露台内，视线高度约 1.4 米，使用 35mm 广角镜头，平视并略微仰拍。无航拍，无鸟瞰。左前景由一根极大的朱漆立柱、油润深色木梁和压入画框顶部的深青色重檐进行强力构图；右侧使用半透明青玉屏风和雕花白玉栏杆形成第二层框架。中景是一个极其宽阔但空旷的皇家白玉露台，抛光的玉石表面反射着冷灰色的天空，尽头仅有 3 位微小的仙人（约占画面高度的 1%）静静伫立。露台之外，直接坠入巨大的云海断层。远方上方，整座倒悬的皇家宫殿从云层之上垂下。它不仅是一座建筑，更是一整块雕刻成宫殿的天空大陆：倒悬的屋檐、巨大的斗拱、白玉平台、深色木柱和深青色琉璃瓦构成了巨大的景观。仅可见部分结构。至少 50% 的倒悬建筑被高空灰蓝色薄雾、云幕、前景屋檐和画框遮挡。最上端的连接处消失在天际，而下垂的末端被蓝灰色云层吞没，使宫殿的厚度和高度显得模糊。部分区域甚至展示了巨大的倒悬庭院和下沉基座，但不要添加第二个视觉主角。约 80% 的画面由灰蓝色天空、蓝灰色云海、冷空气和深青灰色阴影控制。皇家材质极其考究：朱红色高光漆柱、深色木梁、白玉平台、精致玉屏、深青色琉璃瓦檐以及局部镀金的斗拱边缘。金色受到严格控制，仅出现在边缘处。来自右侧的柔和定向光穿过云层，在屋檐和横梁上营造出微量的琥珀色轮廓光。前景细节锐利，中景适中，远处的巨大块面简化为深灰蓝色的剪影。冷色调大场景 + 暖色调局部点缀 + 发光的象牙色薄雾，作为人工地形的纪念碑式倒悬天宫，建筑吞没天空，庄严肃穆，深邃的空气层次感，大景深，无废墟建筑，无拥挤的宫殿群，无科幻飞船感。
